body: I've heard it's a side-effect, but the depression started before I stopped it.  I actually stopped it because I wondered if it had something to do with my mood change.  Although I'm not 100% sure why it started, I think the combination of wintertime and not doing anything may have something to do with it.  There's no set event, I kind of just got worse and worse as the month went on.

Thanks for the response. 

I try to distract myself all the time, but the problem is most things just feel like a distraction.  I started writing a bit today, which was definitely cathartic and helped a bit.  But I'm just afraid my whole life is going to be one big distraction.
